title: Inference passes training in 2026 and keeps pulling away
subtitle: Gartner published the 2026 split. The 2027 split applies Gartner's 59% inference share to its $66.1B total, so it is derived.
caption: Inference grows about 67% year over year in this forecast against 43% for training. Gartner gives no inference share for 2025, so that year is left out rather than invented.
source: Gartner press release, August 10, 2026. Forecast figures.
